series_end_reason: From the Q1 2026 report the brand is no longer a separate line; it sits within a therapy-class line whose footnote names it (long-acting insulin 'Comprises Tresiba, Xultophy, Levemir and Awiqli'). Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 contain no row for the brand.
series_start_reason: Q1 2009 is the first quarter that can be read. The FY2008 report (6-K c99892.htm) is the first to print NovoRapid as a table line, and prints only the full year (7,830). The 2003-2008 interim and annual reports print only the aggregate 'Modern insulins (insulin analogues)' line, so no 2008 quarter is available.
notes: The line is Novo Nordisk's worldwide NovoRapid row. NovoLog is the US trade name of the same insulin aspart: the Q3 2002 report groups them as 'insulin analogues (NovoRapid/NovoLog, NovoMix 30/NovoLog Mix 30)' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/353278/000115697302000654/u45459e6vk.htm), and the reports never print a NovoLog row, so the NovoRapid row is the whole-world insulin aspart line including the US NovoLog. A US-only NovoLog line is not printed as such; the regional columns (North America Operations in older reports, US Operations from 2023) change definition over the span. Quarters 2009Q2-2012Q4 are year-to-date less the preceding year-to-date; from 2013Q1 the reports print a quarter-only regional row and 2013Q1-2025Q4 are read directly. FY2012: the Q4 2012 report has a multi-quarter row (15,693 | 4,294 | 4,052 | 3,829 | 3,518) whose quarter figures differ by 1-2 from the year-to-date differences; the year-to-date derivation is used throughout that year. Insulin aspart is also sold as Fiasp (separate series).
search_log: listed all CIK 0000353278 filings via data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + CIK0000353278-submissions-001.json): foreign private issuer, quarterly reports are Form 6-K exhibits; no 8-K, 8-K/A or 10-Q forms

each quarter read from that quarter's own financial report: 2009Q1-2017Q4 6-K exhibits (c1005xx..f6k_*.htm names), 2018Q1 and 2018Q2 from the novonordisk.com PDFs (the EDGAR copies render tables as images), 2018Q3-2025Q4 caq{q}{yyyy}.htm exhibits

every figure was read programmatically from a cached copy of the cited document; for each year the four quarters were summed and compared with the full-year figure in that year's Q4 report (all years equal)

Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 reports (caq12026.htm, caq22026.htm): no product row for this brand in any table; footnotes read 'Comprises Tresiba, Xultophy, Levemir and Awiqli' (long-acting), 'Comprises Ryzodeg and NovoMix' (premix), 'Comprises Fiasp and NovoRapid' (fast-acting), so the brand lines end with Q4 2025

FY2008 report (6-K 0001208646-09-000006, c99892.htm): '- NovoRapid | 7,830' is the first NovoRapid table line; the Q1 2008 (c98404.htm), H1 2008 (c99004.htm) and 9M 2008 (c99489.htm) reports print only 'Modern insulins (insulin analogues)'; the 2002-2007 6-Ks above 150 kB on the submissions index were grepped for a NovoRapid line with a figure of 1,000 or more and none was found (the 2002 Q3 report mentions NovoRapid only in a product list)
2012Q4: the row 'novorapid | 9,033 | 2,514 ...' is an area row, not the quarter; Q4 2012 taken as FY 15,693 less 9M 11,400 = 4,293
FDA Drugs@FDA NDA 020986 page fetched: '06/07/2000 ORIG-1 Approval N/A'

reviewed_anomalies.2024Q4: Total 5,674 with a US column of 3,397 against about 1,500-1,650 in the adjacent quarters; the four quarters sum to the stated full year (16,653) and the figure is kept as printed; the cause was not established from the documents read.
